cmake_minimum_required(VERSION 3.20)
project(PS3RecompWindowsWorkspace LANGUAGES C CXX)
# This top-level CMake entry point builds the toolkit runtime only.
# The title-specific EXE is generated by BUILD_PS3_GAME.ps1 after PPU lifting.
add_subdirectory("${CMAKE_CURRENT_SOURCE_DIR}/ps3recomp-master" "${CMAKE_BINARY_DIR}/ps3recomp_runtime")
